definitions.AGGREGATE_RTFX_DEFINITION: Sum of offered audio seconds over every measured session, including sessions that produced no transcript, divided by the benchmark wall span from the first stream start to the last stream finish. Under real-time pacing this tracks stream count: a concurrency measure, not a speedup. successful_audio_s is reported beside the ratio. streaming_rtfx is the productive-audio ratio on the cell span and is not this number.
definitions.AUDIO_CLOCK_ORIGIN_DEFINITION: Audio t=0 on the client monotonic clock: audio offset a was capturable at origin + a. riva-grpc records its pacing schedule origin (schedule_origin). An outcome without one derives it: a paced session uses first-audio-sent minus the first chunk's duration, since a paced chunk is sent once it could have been captured (first_send_minus_first_chunk); an unpaced session uses first-audio-sent (first_send). Frontier lag, word latency, and pacing fidelity all use it, and each block counts which source every session used.
definitions.AUDIO_CONDITION_DEFINITION: native sends each clip as staged, 16 kHz PCM16. telephony_8k low-passes at 3.8 kHz, decimates to 8 kHz, and sends 8 kHz PCM16 with sample_rate_hertz 8000. telephony_8k_in_16k applies the same decimation, interpolates back to 16 kHz with the same filter, and sends 16 kHz PCM16: narrowband content at the wideband rate, for a server that accepts only 16 kHz. The filter is named by dataset.audio_condition.resampler. Clip and manifest digests name the source audio; the condition and the sent rate are separate workload identity, so 8 kHz and 16 kHz receipts of the same clips share a source digest and differ in fingerprint.
definitions.AUDIO_DENOMINATOR_DEFINITION: attempted_audio_s sums clip duration over every measured session, including failures. successful_audio_s sums clip duration over productive sessions only. Both are reported.
definitions.CER_DEFINITION: Character error rate under the same named normalization policy as the accompanying WER, over the normalized utterance text. Not interchangeable across policies.
definitions.CHUNK_LATENCY_DEFINITION: Per-chunk coverage latency. For chunk i with send time s_i and cumulative audio end E_i, the receive time of the first response j with r_j >= s_i whose covered audio a_j >= E_i, minus s_i. Population is chunks, as NVIDIA's. a_j is the response's audio_processed when the session's audio_processed is trusted: present on every non-final response, never decreasing, and never more than CHUNK_LATENCY_AUDIO_PROCESSED_SLACK_S beyond the audio sent by then (coverage_source audio_processed). Otherwise a_j is the send watermark, E_k of the last chunk sent by r_j (coverage_source send_watermark), a lower bound. On a server that answers chunk i before chunk i + 1 is sent it equals riva_client_compat_s pair for pair; on other servers it shows the server's own buffering, and a duplicate or back-to-back response cannot move it because the first covering response wins. availability is measured for audio_processed coverage, measured_lower_bound when any session used the watermark, and final_only when every measured session sent finals only (interim_results off on a server that does not answer per chunk): then no number is published, because the degenerate value would be about half the clip. A chunk no response covered is counted, not sampled. A session that sent chunks and got no response is counted as no_responses, its chunks as uncovered, and is not a coverage source. Unpaced, chunk_latency_s is not_applicable (pacing_disabled), as riva_client_compat_s is. n_responses, n_bursts (consecutive responses under CHUNK_LATENCY_BURST_GAP_S apart), and n_text_repeats (consecutive identical interim texts) are diagnostics. Not finalization_s.
definitions.CHUNK_LATENCY_FINAL_FLAGS_INFERRED: When an outcome carries no response_final_flags (receipts before schema 6), a session with no interim at all is taken to have sent finals only; otherwise every response, the real final included, is taken as non-final, so n_chunks_covered_by_final reads 0 for those sessions.
definitions.CLIP_ASSIGNMENT_DEFINITION: round_robin: with a corpus manifest, the session on lane l at iteration i of its phase plays manifest clip (i * lanes + l) mod clip_count. Concurrent sessions play different clips, every trial replays the same assignment, and every clip is played only when lanes * iterations >= clip_count; wer.corpus.complete records it.
definitions.COMPARISON_KEY_DEFINITION: sha256 of the canonical JSON texts of the workload fingerprint, the hard target identity, the hard software identity, and the hard hardware identity, in that order, joined by U+001F. The hard target identity is the checkpoint id, revision, and source. It is not target.model and not server_version. The comparison axis is engine: engine name, engine version, transport, and server_version are recorded beside the key and a mismatch does not refuse. The adapter name is recorded with the transport and is not hard software identity. chunk_ms, att_context_right, lookahead frame count, and cadence are inside the workload fingerprint. The millisecond label is not. Decode features in that fingerprint are language, punctuation, diarization, interim_results, decoder, language_model, and enable_word_time_offsets. word_time_offsets_sent is true only when that flag is set and the transport sends word offsets, so a declaration the adapter does not send does not match a run that sent them. Hard software identity includes normalization policy, percentile method, SCHEMA_VERSION, and MEASUREMENT_SEMANTICS_VERSION. Precision is recorded and is not this key. Warn-only mismatches are listed and do not refuse.
definitions.COMPLETION_FRACTION_DEFINITION: Fraction of measured sessions that completed. A named policy a preset may select in place of the steady-interval condition. It is not that condition.
definitions.CORPUS_NORMALIZATION_DEFINITION: corpus_reference applies full normalization: case-fold, strip control tags, strip punctuation, normalize English cardinals (en_cardinals_v1, 0 through 999, including the 'and' form), and collapse whitespace.
definitions.CORPUS_NORMALIZER_DEFINITION: Under corpus_reference, pass_policy.corpus_normalizer names the text normalizer applied to reference and hypothesis alike. en_cardinals_v1 is the built-in stdlib normalizer described by CORPUS_NORMALIZATION_DEFINITION; English only. open_asr_english_v1 is the Open ASR Leaderboard EnglishTextNormalizer (Whisper-derived: fillers, spelling variants, numbers, currencies, ordinals), vendored at OPEN_ASR_NORMALIZER_COMMIT; English only. open_asr_multilingual_v1 dispatches as the leaderboard's scorer does: English to that normalizer, any other language to MultilingualNormalizer(remove_diacritics=False) with lang set to the workload language's primary subtag (digits to words via num2words), then normalize_compound_pairs on each reference/hypothesis pair. Angle and square bracket tags are stripped first, as en_cardinals_v1 does. kaldialign merge_compounds is not replicated, and the leaderboard's Chinese and Armenian normalizers are not vendored, so zh and hy take the basic multilingual path; wer.normalizer.parity says which. The open_asr normalizers need the asrbench[wer-multilingual] extra. WER is comparable only between receipts with the same policy and the same normalizer.
definitions.CORPUS_WER_DEFINITION: Corpus WER: total edits (substitutions + alignment deletions + insertions + deletions_from_missing_transcript) over total reference words, pooled over every measured session of every clip. A long clip weighs by its words, as the Open ASR Leaderboard and NVIDIA's published accuracy tables reduce a test set. Equal to micro_wer. Only a complete run (every clip scored) and a balanced one (every clip played equally often) is the test-set number.
definitions.E2E_RTFX_DEFINITION: Per measured session, offered audio seconds divided by the client-monotonic interval from the first audio sample sent to the final result received. Real-time pacing caps this near 1. Read it as kept up, not as speed. A session that did not complete, including a timeout, a protocol error, or an early final on a failed stream, stays in n_total and contributes no ratio. A completed session missing either timestamp stays in n_total and is absent from n_with_measure. Not streaming_rtfx and not a vendor per-chunk latency.
definitions.EMISSION_LAG_DEFINITION: A word's audio ending to that word's first appearance in any output. Requires construction-time ground truth: silence of an exact frame count between known utterances. Not inferred by a forced aligner or a voice-activity detector.
definitions.FINALIZATION_DEFINITION: Seconds from the last audio sample sent to the final result received, on the client monotonic clock. A session that did not complete stays in n_total and contributes no sample. A negative on a completed session is kept. Not NVIDIA's "final latency" column: riva_streaming_asr_client pairs response i with chunk i and drops the trailing final, so its final column is riva_client_compat_final_s, never this metric.
definitions.FRONTIER_DEFINITION: Accuracy against measured latency, one point per receipt, identified by lookahead frame count and the cadence that sets it. The millisecond label is carried beside the point and is not the identity. Latency is pooled TTFS p50 and accuracy is pooled micro WER, each under the clock and normalization policy the receipt already names. The Pareto edge is the set of points with no other point both faster and more accurate. A dominated point is a finding, not a pass failure. Cross-cadence transcript agreement is not computed. Points are grouped by comparison identity with lookahead frame count and cadence removed, so a lookahead sweep that also changes cadence is one series, and different hardware or checkpoints are not drawn on one edge.
definitions.FRONTIER_LAG_DEFINITION: For each audio_processed sample, client-monotonic receive time minus the sum of the audio clock origin and audio_processed at that sample. The origin is audio t=0 on the client clock (AUDIO_CLOCK_ORIGIN_DEFINITION), not first-audio-sent, which under real-time pacing is one chunk later and would bias every sample by minus chunk_ms. Negatives are kept. Invalid when audio_processed decreases on that stream. Unavailable when audio_processed or the audio clock origin is absent. An invalid or absent session stays in n_total and contributes no sample. Not response latency and not the Riva client compat statistic.
definitions.FRONTIER_RTFX_DEFINITION: Per consecutive audio_processed samples on one stream, the increase in audio_processed divided by the client-monotonic receive interval. Independent of how the transcript is segmented. Invalid when audio_processed decreases on that stream. Unavailable when the transport did not report audio_processed. An invalid or absent session stays in n_total and contributes no ratio.
definitions.GOODPUT_DEFINITION: Measured sessions that simultaneously were admitted, produced a first partial, met the named latency SLO on that session's own samples, completed, and — when a reference was declared — scored within the accuracy tolerance, divided by the measured cell wall span in seconds. Not computed while the sustainability policy is unevaluable, so a missing steady interval cannot become a goodput.
definitions.HARDWARE_IDENTITY_DEFINITION: The hard hardware identity is gpu_name, gpu_count, gpu_memory_mib, and gpu_identity_source. Those GPU fields are the server declaration when the target spec carries one, otherwise the client nvidia-smi probe, and gpu_identity_source says which. Driver version, client CPU, host, and probe status are warn-only and are not this identity. The run does not require a GPU.
definitions.INTERIM_CADENCE_DEFINITION: Distribution of inter-interim arrival intervals against the configured cadence. Unavailable until outcomes carry interim arrival timestamps.
definitions.LAG_EXCESS_DEFINITION: Emission lag minus the cadence's theoretical floor: what the implementation costs above what the configuration costs. Unavailable when emission lag is unavailable. Raw emission lag is not compared across cadences.
definitions.LANE_UNAVAILABLE_DEFINITION: A session whose adapter set terminal_status to lane_unavailable: an entitled lane this process could not open. The session stays in the population. It is not a crash of the run.
definitions.LOOKAHEAD_IDENTITY_DEFINITION: An operating point is identified by lookahead frame count. The millisecond label is carried beside it and is not identity, because vendors disagree on that convention by one frame. Policy client_declared uses the frame count the workload requested. Policy server_reported_when_present uses a server-reported frame count when an outcome carries one; none do yet, so the client count is used and server_reported_lookahead_frames is null. The policy name is warn-only until an adapter reports a frame count, so naming the unused policy does not refuse a comparison.
definitions.MANIFEST_DIGEST_DEFINITION: sha256 over canonical JSON of the manifest schema, its language, and per clip in manifest order the clip id, the sha256 of its PCM16 payload, and the sha256 of its UTF-8 reference text. Paths, notes, and provenance are not covered. Part of the workload fingerprint: a changed clip, a changed reference, or a reordered manifest is different offered work.
definitions.NVIDIA_OFFLINE_ROW_DEFINITION: One row per offline receipt in NVIDIA's offline table layout: parallel requests (lanes) and throughput, the trial mean of aggregate_rtfx. throughput_rtfx_server is the trial mean of server_audio_rtfx, riva_asr_client's own numerator, and throughput_server_gap flags a mismatch above 0.5%. Latency columns are finalization_s in milliseconds, the request latency riva_asr_client prints; latency_source says asrbench_only because NVIDIA's offline tables have no latency columns. Comparable (throughput only) when every request completed in every trial and percentile_method is floor_index; riva_asr_client prints no throughput when any request failed.
definitions.NVIDIA_STREAMING_ROW_DEFINITION: One row per receipt in NVIDIA's ASR NIM streaming table layout. Latency avg, p50, p90, p95, and p99 are milliseconds, each the mean over trials of the per-trial value, as NVIDIA averages three runs; the *_std columns are the sample standard deviation over trials. latency_source names what filled them: riva_compat (riva_client_compat_s, NVIDIA's recv[i] - send[i]) when every trial measured it; otherwise chunk_coverage/audio_processed or chunk_coverage/send_watermark (chunk_latency_s, a lower bound) when the server is not one response per chunk; n/a when the server sent finals only. Throughput is the trial mean of aggregate_rtfx, offered audio over the trial wall span. comparable is true only when latency_source is riva_compat or chunk_coverage/audio_processed on every trial, percentile_method is floor_index, pacing_validity is paced, interim_results and enable_word_time_offsets are off, and iterations per lane is at least 3 (NVIDIA runs exactly 3; more changes the sample size); not_comparable lists each gate that failed. chunk_coverage/audio_processed counts as comparable though NVIDIA's own client would print nothing for such a server; it equals recv[i] - send[i] where that exists. A trial where any session sent chunks and got no response is not measured. final_avg_ms is NVIDIA's final split (riva_client_compat_final_s); finalization_p50_ms beside it is asrbench's last-audio-to-final and is not that column.
definitions.NVIDIA_TRIAL_STD_DEFINITION: Sample standard deviation (n - 1) of the per-trial values a column averages. Null with fewer than two trials. NVIDIA rounds by it, so it is needed to judge whether two rows match.
definitions.OFFLINE_RTFX_DEFINITION: Successfully transcribed audio seconds divided by the wall-clock span of an unpaced offline cell. A throughput ratio. Not interchangeable with streaming RTFX. A streaming cell with pacing disabled is not this measure.
definitions.ORACLE_NORMALIZATION_DEFINITION: engine_vs_own_oracle compares raw text after whitespace tokenization only. No case-folding, no punctuation stripping, no tag stripping, and no number normalization.
definitions.OUTCOME_ACCOUNTING_DEFINITION: Counts over every measured session. attempted is the population. admitted is configured. completed is a terminal transcript without timeout or protocol error, including an empty transcript. productive is completed with a non-empty transcript. timed-out and errored are mutually exclusive, and a timeout wins when both signals are present. no-first-partial overlaps those buckets. lane_unavailable counts sessions the adapter labeled as an entitled lane this process could not open. Warmup sessions are excluded from attempted and recorded as warmup_excluded.
definitions.PACING_FIDELITY_DEFINITION: Per paced session with a client send trace, the lag of chunk i is its send time minus (audio clock origin + E_i), where E_i is the cumulative audio end of chunk i, min(audio duration, (i + 1) * chunk_ms). Every chunk is scored, the shorter last chunk included. The origin is the recorded schedule origin, so a late first chunk is visible; see AUDIO_CLOCK_ORIGIN_DEFINITION for outcomes that did not record one. Positive is late. Lags from every measured session are pooled. max_session_lag_s is the largest lag in any session. A validity check on every other latency in the cell, not a performance number. A session without a send trace stays in n_total and contributes no lag.
definitions.PACING_FIDELITY_TOLERANCE_DEFINITION: A paced cell is paced when every measured lag is at most max(5 ms, 5% of chunk_ms), against latencies of a few to a few hundred milliseconds. Up to one chunk_ms it is pacing_lagged. Beyond one chunk it is unpaced: the client fell behind real time, so throughput and latency describe the client as well as the server. Only paced feeds a comparable NVIDIA row.
definitions.PASS_CONJUNCTION_DEFINITION: A cell passes only when every clause passes on that cell: admission fraction, first-partial presence, the latency SLO at the declared percentile of the named latency metric, the named sustainability policy, and accuracy within tolerance under the named normalization policy. The named latency metric is ttfs, response_latency, finalization, or frontier_lag. TTFS stays selectable and is secondary. The headline latency measures are finalization and frontier lag. An unevaluable clause fails the conjunction. The report names the clause. Cross-cadence transcript agreement is not a clause.
definitions.PERCENTILE_FLOOR_INDEX_DEFINITION: floor_index: zero-based index = min(floor(q / 100 * n), n - 1) into the sorted sample. Empty input is absent, not zero. Named for a table placed next to Riva's published percentiles. Not the default.
definitions.PERCENTILE_LINEAR_DEFINITION: numpy_linear, Hyndman-Fan type 7, the NumPy default percentile: rank = (n - 1) * (q / 100), linearly interpolated between the closest order statistics. q is in [0, 100]. Empty input is absent, not zero. nearest_rank and floor_index are the named alternatives.
definitions.PERCENTILE_NEAREST_RANK_DEFINITION: nearest_rank: 1-based rank = max(1, ceil(q / 100 * n)), clamped to n. Empty input is absent, not zero. Named alternative to numpy_linear. Not the default.
definitions.PER_CLIP_MEAN_WER_DEFINITION: Secondary. Each clip's WER pooled over its own sessions, then the unweighted mean over clips with a defined rate. A one-word clip weighs as much as a thousand-word clip, so this is not the published corpus number; it shows whether a few clips carry the errors.
definitions.PER_UTTERANCE_WER_DEFINITION: Distribution of per-utterance word error rates under the named policy. The micro-average is a separate number. A mean of rates hides a catastrophic utterance, so both are reported. Utterances without a defined rate stay in n_total.
definitions.POPULATION_DEFINITION: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.
definitions.PRECISION_RECORD_DEFINITION: precision is recorded under the NVIDIA names FP32, FP16, FP8, and INT8, joined with + when mixed, plus an optional tf32 flag. It is shown beside a comparison and is not a comparison key. No further precision rule is applied.
definitions.PREFIX_VIOLATION_DEFINITION: Count of prefix checks that fail, with no normalization. Each recorded interim is checked against the next interim, and each recorded interim is checked against the final. One interim can contribute twice. An interim count without interim text is not this measure.
definitions.PRODUCTIVE_DEFINITION: A measured session that was configured, received a non-empty final transcript, and was not timed out and not errored.
definitions.RESPONSE_LATENCY_DEFINITION: Seconds from the most recent audio transmitted to each non-empty interim, on one client monotonic clock. One sample per response, not per stream. Not TTFS. Client and server clocks are never subtracted.
definitions.REVISION_RATE_DEFINITION: Revised whitespace tokens divided by newly emitted whitespace tokens. The first interim contributes every token; each later interim contributes only tokens past the common token prefix of the previous interim. A revised token falls outside the common token prefix of the following interim, or of the final for the last interim. Not a word error rate. Cross-cadence transcript agreement is not this metric and is not a pass condition.
definitions.RIVA_CLIENT_COMPAT_DEFINITION: Labelled Riva client compat only. Receive time of response i minus send time of chunk i, for every chunk i. Valid when the response count equals the chunk count or the chunk count plus one; the trailing extra response is ignored, as riva_streaming_asr_client does. Any other count makes the session, and so the statistic, invalid. An adapter may omit a protocol event from those lists before pairing. Not applicable when the workload is not paced: riva_streaming_asr_client prints latency only under --simulate_realtime. Not a headline. Not frontier lag, not finalization, and not TTFS.
definitions.RIVA_CLIENT_COMPAT_SPLIT_DEFINITION: The riva_client_compat_s pairs, split by whether response i carried a result with is_final true (final) or not (intermediate), as riva_streaming_asr_client splits its intermediate and final latency lists. Same validity as the pooled statistic. Unavailable when the adapter did not record one final flag per response. The final side is NVIDIA's "final latency" by code, not finalization_s: when the final rides the trailing extra response it is ignored, as the client ignores it, so this side often holds no real final. finalization_s (last audio sent to final) is the asrbench measure of finalization and is never substituted here.
definitions.RIVA_OFFLINE_RECOGNIZE_DEFINITION: In offline mode riva-grpc sends the whole clip in one unary Recognize, as riva_asr_client does. First and last audio sent are both the call start and the final is the response, so finalization_s is that client's per-request latency and TTFS is empty. Lanes are requests kept in flight. aggregate_rtfx is offered audio over the trial span, the analogue of the client's throughput RTFX, biased low: the asrbench span also covers each session's channel open and GetRivaSpeechRecognitionConfig call and the lane barrier, which riva_asr_client does once before its timer starts. offline_rtfx counts productive audio only. word_latency_s is not_applicable offline. The client sums the server's audio_processed; asrbench uses the clip duration, keeps the server value as server_audio_processed_s residue, and reports server_audio_rtfx beside it (SERVER_AUDIO_RTFX_DEFINITION).
definitions.RIVA_PACING_SCHEDULE_DEFINITION: riva-grpc paces against an absolute schedule from stream start, as riva_streaming_asr_client does: chunk i is sent no earlier than stream start plus i times chunk_ms plus the duration of chunk i, so audio is never sent before it would have been recorded and a late wake-up does not delay every later chunk. Here stream start is taken after the config write and the cohort barrier release, not before the config write as in the NVIDIA client, so chunk 0 waits its own duration from that point.
definitions.RUNNER_HANG_GUARD_DEFINITION: The runner hang guard waits twice timeout_s, plus one timeout_s for the cohort barrier, plus the clip duration when pacing, plus 0.25 seconds. realtime-ws may spend timeout_s waiting for session.updated and timeout_s again waiting for the final, and a peer may spend timeout_s at the barrier on the slowest handshake. The adapter owns each timeout_s and may return a partial outcome. The guard replaces the outcome only when the adapter does not return.
definitions.SDI_DEFINITION: Alignment substitutions, deletions, and insertions counted separately from deletions_from_missing_transcript. The backtrace is deterministic: on a cost tie it prefers a substitution, then a deletion, then an insertion.
definitions.SERVER_AUDIO_RTFX_DEFINITION: Offline only. Sum over completed requests of the server's audio_processed on the last result of each response, divided by the benchmark wall span: riva_asr_client's throughput numerator. gap_vs_clip is server audio over completed clip audio minus one. mismatch is true when the absolute gap exceeds SERVER_AUDIO_RTFX_MISMATCH_TOLERANCE, meaning the server counted a different amount of audio than the clip holds. Unavailable when a completed request carried no audio_processed. Not applicable in streaming mode.
definitions.STEADY_INTERVAL_DEFINITION: Sustainability over a declared steady interval of the cell. Unevaluable until outcomes carry that interval. Fail-closed: the clause does not pass.
definitions.STREAMING_RTFX_DEFINITION: Successfully transcribed audio seconds divided by the wall-clock span of the measured cell, warmup excluded from the span. Under real-time pacing this tracks stream count: it is a concurrency measure, not a speedup and not an inference-speed number. The numerator is productive audio only. Without a client send trace the ratio is unqualified, because pacing fidelity is what says the client actually paced.
definitions.SUSTAINED_STREAMS_DEFINITION: Largest offered concurrency at which the full pass conjunction still holds. One cell reports its offered lanes and whether its conjunction passed. It does not invent a sweep maximum. A sweep projection may take the maximum passing lanes across receipts that share an operating point aside from lane count.
definitions.TTFS_DEFINITION: Seconds from the first audio sample transmitted to the first non-empty partial, on one client monotonic clock. Connection, configuration, and admission wait are not included. Under riva-grpc real-time pacing the first chunk is sent one chunk after the schedule origin, once that chunk could have been captured, so TTFS starts after that wait, as riva_streaming_asr_client's first send does. A session with no non-empty partial stays in n_total and is absent from n_with_measure. This is not a vendor response latency and not vLLM TTFT.
definitions.VLLM_FORMAT_NOTE: Shaped like a vLLM serving-benchmark summary so a serving engineer can read the counts. ttfs_s is this project's time to first non-empty partial. response_latency_s is per response. e2e_rtfx is offered audio divided by first-audio-to-final. None of these is vLLM TTFT, and none is a vendor per-chunk latency. riva_client_compat_s is the labelled chunk-i/response-i Riva client compat statistic and is not a headline.
definitions.WARN_ONLY_COMPARISON_DEFINITION: Warn-only mismatches are recorded and do not refuse: target.model, transport_options, batch_size, max_num_seqs, gpu_memory_utilization, CUDA version, torch version, GPU driver version, client_location, Python version, asrbench git commit and dirty bit, endpoint_url, tls_verify, auth_env, package version, lookahead identity policy, client CPU, host, probe status, and channel_options. channel_options are keepalive and maximum message size. A checkpoint whose source is unverified is flagged and does not by itself refuse when the declared checkpoint matches.
definitions.WER_DEFINITION: Word error rate (substitutions + alignment deletions + insertions + deletions_from_missing_transcript) / reference words, micro-averaged, under the named normalization policy. A session with a reference and no transcript stays in the denominator as deletions_from_missing_transcript and is not an alignment deletion. n_failed counts those sessions. A received empty transcript is an empty hypothesis and its deletions are alignment deletions. A session with no reference stays in n_total and is absent from n_with_measure. Undefined when the reference-word denominator is zero and any edit remains.
definitions.WORD_LATENCY_DEFINITION: Client-monotonic time of the final that carried the word, minus the audio clock origin (AUDIO_CLOCK_ORIGIN_DEFINITION) plus word.end_time in seconds on the paced audio clock. Requires enable_word_time_offsets. Negatives are kept. Unavailable when word end times were not recorded. Not applicable in offline mode: there is no paced audio clock.

audio_denominators.definition: attempted_audio_s sums clip duration over every measured session, including failures. successful_audio_s sums clip duration over productive sessions only. Both are reported.

lookahead.definition: An operating point is identified by lookahead frame count. The millisecond label is carried beside it and is not identity, because vendors disagree on that convention by one frame. Policy client_declared uses the frame count the workload requested. Policy server_reported_when_present uses a server-reported frame count when an outcome carries one; none do yet, so the client count is used and server_reported_lookahead_frames is null. The policy name is warn-only until an adapter reports a frame count, so naming the unused policy does not refuse a comparison.

outcomes.label: t0-lane0-i0
outcomes.transcript: the birch canoe slid on the smooth planks

counts.definition: Counts over every measured session. attempted is the population. admitted is configured. completed is a terminal transcript without timeout or protocol error, including an empty transcript. productive is completed with a non-empty transcript. timed-out and errored are mutually exclusive, and a timeout wins when both signals are present. no-first-partial overlaps those buckets. lane_unavailable counts sessions the adapter labeled as an entitled lane this process could not open. Warmup sessions are excluded from attempted and recorded as warmup_excluded.

ttfs_s.name: ttfs_s
ttfs_s.definition: Seconds from the first audio sample transmitted to the first non-empty partial, on one client monotonic clock. Connection, configuration, and admission wait are not included. Under riva-grpc real-time pacing the first chunk is sent one chunk after the schedule origin, once that chunk could have been captured, so TTFS starts after that wait, as riva_streaming_asr_client's first send does. A session with no non-empty partial stays in n_total and is absent from n_with_measure. This is not a vendor response latency and not vLLM TTFT.
ttfs_s.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

response_latency_s.name: response_latency_s
response_latency_s.definition: Seconds from the most recent audio transmitted to each non-empty interim, on one client monotonic clock. One sample per response, not per stream. Not TTFS. Client and server clocks are never subtracted.
response_latency_s.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

finalization_s.name: finalization_s
finalization_s.definition: Seconds from the last audio sample sent to the final result received, on the client monotonic clock. A session that did not complete stays in n_total and contributes no sample. A negative on a completed session is kept. Not NVIDIA's "final latency" column: riva_streaming_asr_client pairs response i with chunk i and drops the trailing final, so its final column is riva_client_compat_final_s, never this metric.
finalization_s.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

e2e_rtfx.name: e2e_rtfx
e2e_rtfx.definition: Per measured session, offered audio seconds divided by the client-monotonic interval from the first audio sample sent to the final result received. Real-time pacing caps this near 1. Read it as kept up, not as speed. A session that did not complete, including a timeout, a protocol error, or an early final on a failed stream, stays in n_total and contributes no ratio. A completed session missing either timestamp stays in n_total and is absent from n_with_measure. Not streaming_rtfx and not a vendor per-chunk latency.
e2e_rtfx.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

frontier_rtfx.name: frontier_rtfx
frontier_rtfx.definition: Per consecutive audio_processed samples on one stream, the increase in audio_processed divided by the client-monotonic receive interval. Independent of how the transcript is segmented. Invalid when audio_processed decreases on that stream. Unavailable when the transport did not report audio_processed. An invalid or absent session stays in n_total and contributes no ratio.
frontier_rtfx.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

frontier_lag_s.name: frontier_lag_s
frontier_lag_s.definition: For each audio_processed sample, client-monotonic receive time minus the sum of the audio clock origin and audio_processed at that sample. The origin is audio t=0 on the client clock (AUDIO_CLOCK_ORIGIN_DEFINITION), not first-audio-sent, which under real-time pacing is one chunk later and would bias every sample by minus chunk_ms. Negatives are kept. Invalid when audio_processed decreases on that stream. Unavailable when audio_processed or the audio clock origin is absent. An invalid or absent session stays in n_total and contributes no sample. Not response latency and not the Riva client compat statistic.
frontier_lag_s.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.
frontier_lag_s.audio_clock_origin_definition: Audio t=0 on the client monotonic clock: audio offset a was capturable at origin + a. riva-grpc records its pacing schedule origin (schedule_origin). An outcome without one derives it: a paced session uses first-audio-sent minus the first chunk's duration, since a paced chunk is sent once it could have been captured (first_send_minus_first_chunk); an unpaced session uses first-audio-sent (first_send). Frontier lag, word latency, and pacing fidelity all use it, and each block counts which source every session used.

word_latency_s.name: word_latency_s
word_latency_s.definition: Client-monotonic time of the final that carried the word, minus the audio clock origin (AUDIO_CLOCK_ORIGIN_DEFINITION) plus word.end_time in seconds on the paced audio clock. Requires enable_word_time_offsets. Negatives are kept. Unavailable when word end times were not recorded. Not applicable in offline mode: there is no paced audio clock.
word_latency_s.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.
word_latency_s.audio_clock_origin_definition: Audio t=0 on the client monotonic clock: audio offset a was capturable at origin + a. riva-grpc records its pacing schedule origin (schedule_origin). An outcome without one derives it: a paced session uses first-audio-sent minus the first chunk's duration, since a paced chunk is sent once it could have been captured (first_send_minus_first_chunk); an unpaced session uses first-audio-sent (first_send). Frontier lag, word latency, and pacing fidelity all use it, and each block counts which source every session used.

aggregate_rtfx.name: aggregate_rtfx
aggregate_rtfx.definition: Sum of offered audio seconds over every measured session, including sessions that produced no transcript, divided by the benchmark wall span from the first stream start to the last stream finish. Under real-time pacing this tracks stream count: a concurrency measure, not a speedup. successful_audio_s is reported beside the ratio. streaming_rtfx is the productive-audio ratio on the cell span and is not this number.

riva_client_compat_s.name: riva_client_compat_s
riva_client_compat_s.label: Riva client compat
riva_client_compat_s.definition: Labelled Riva client compat only. Receive time of response i minus send time of chunk i, for every chunk i. Valid when the response count equals the chunk count or the chunk count plus one; the trailing extra response is ignored, as riva_streaming_asr_client does. Any other count makes the session, and so the statistic, invalid. An adapter may omit a protocol event from those lists before pairing. Not applicable when the workload is not paced: riva_streaming_asr_client prints latency only under --simulate_realtime. Not a headline. Not frontier lag, not finalization, and not TTFS.
riva_client_compat_s.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

riva_client_compat_intermediate_s.name: riva_client_compat_intermediate_s
riva_client_compat_intermediate_s.label: Riva client compat
riva_client_compat_intermediate_s.definition: The riva_client_compat_s pairs, split by whether response i carried a result with is_final true (final) or not (intermediate), as riva_streaming_asr_client splits its intermediate and final latency lists. Same validity as the pooled statistic. Unavailable when the adapter did not record one final flag per response. The final side is NVIDIA's "final latency" by code, not finalization_s: when the final rides the trailing extra response it is ignored, as the client ignores it, so this side often holds no real final. finalization_s (last audio sent to final) is the asrbench measure of finalization and is never substituted here.
riva_client_compat_intermediate_s.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

riva_client_compat_final_s.name: riva_client_compat_final_s
riva_client_compat_final_s.label: Riva client compat
riva_client_compat_final_s.definition: The riva_client_compat_s pairs, split by whether response i carried a result with is_final true (final) or not (intermediate), as riva_streaming_asr_client splits its intermediate and final latency lists. Same validity as the pooled statistic. Unavailable when the adapter did not record one final flag per response. chunk_latency_s.name: chunk_latency_s
chunk_latency_s.label: per-chunk coverage latency
chunk_latency_s.definition: Per-chunk coverage latency. For chunk i with send time s_i and cumulative audio end E_i, the receive time of the first response j with r_j >= s_i whose covered audio a_j >= E_i, minus s_i. Population is chunks, as NVIDIA's. a_j is the response's audio_processed when the session's audio_processed is trusted: present on every non-final response, never decreasing, and never more than CHUNK_LATENCY_AUDIO_PROCESSED_SLACK_S beyond the audio sent by then (coverage_source audio_processed). Otherwise a_j is the send watermark, E_k of the last chunk sent by r_j (coverage_source send_watermark), a lower bound. On a server that answers chunk i before chunk i + 1 is sent it equals riva_client_compat_s pair for pair; on other servers it shows the server's own buffering, and a duplicate or back-to-back response cannot move it because the first covering response wins. availability is measured for audio_processed coverage, measured_lower_bound when any session used the watermark, and final_only when every measured session sent finals only (interim_results off on a server that does not answer per chunk): then no number is published, because the degenerate value would be about half the clip. A chunk no response covered is counted, not sampled. A session that sent chunks and got no response is counted as no_responses, its chunks as uncovered, and is not a coverage source. Unpaced, chunk_latency_s is not_applicable (pacing_disabled), as riva_client_compat_s is. n_responses, n_bursts (consecutive responses under CHUNK_LATENCY_BURST_GAP_S apart), and n_text_repeats (consecutive identical interim texts) are diagnostics. Not finalization_s.
chunk_latency_s.final_flags_inferred_definition: When an outcome carries no response_final_flags (receipts before schema 6), a session with no interim at all is taken to have sent finals only; otherwise every response, the real final included, is taken as non-final, so n_chunks_covered_by_final reads 0 for those sessions.

Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

server_audio_rtfx.name: server_audio_rtfx
server_audio_rtfx.definition: Offline only. Sum over completed requests of the server's audio_processed on the last result of each response, divided by the benchmark wall span: riva_asr_client's throughput numerator. gap_vs_clip is server audio over completed clip audio minus one. mismatch is true when the absolute gap exceeds SERVER_AUDIO_RTFX_MISMATCH_TOLERANCE, meaning the server counted a different amount of audio than the clip holds. Unavailable when a completed request carried no audio_processed. Not applicable in streaming mode.

pacing_fidelity.name: pacing_fidelity
pacing_fidelity.definition: Per paced session with a client send trace, the lag of chunk i is its send time minus (audio clock origin + E_i), where E_i is the cumulative audio end of chunk i, min(audio duration, (i + 1) * chunk_ms). Every chunk is scored, the shorter last chunk included. The origin is the recorded schedule origin, so a late first chunk is visible; see AUDIO_CLOCK_ORIGIN_DEFINITION for outcomes that did not record one. Positive is late. Lags from every measured session are pooled. max_session_lag_s is the largest lag in any session. A validity check on every other latency in the cell, not a performance number. A session without a send trace stays in n_total and contributes no lag.
pacing_fidelity.tolerance_definition: A paced cell is paced when every measured lag is at most max(5 ms, 5% of chunk_ms), against latencies of a few to a few hundred milliseconds. Up to one chunk_ms it is pacing_lagged. Beyond one chunk it is unpaced: the client fell behind real time, so throughput and latency describe the client as well as the server. Only paced feeds a comparable NVIDIA row.
pacing_fidelity.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

wer.definition: Word error rate (substitutions + alignment deletions + insertions + deletions_from_missing_transcript) / reference words, micro-averaged, under the named normalization policy. A session with a reference and no transcript stays in the denominator as deletions_from_missing_transcript and is not an alignment deletion. n_failed counts those sessions. A received empty transcript is an empty hypothesis and its deletions are alignment deletions. A session with no reference stays in n_total and is absent from n_with_measure. Undefined when the reference-word denominator is zero and any edit remains.
wer.normalization_definition: engine_vs_own_oracle compares raw text after whitespace tokenization only. No case-folding, no punctuation stripping, no tag stripping, and no number normalization.
wer.cer_definition: Character error rate under the same named normalization policy as the accompanying WER, over the normalized utterance text. Not interchangeable across policies.
wer.sdi_definition: Alignment substitutions, deletions, and insertions counted separately from deletions_from_missing_transcript. The backtrace is deterministic: on a cost tie it prefers a substitution, then a deletion, then an insertion.

per_utterance_wer.name: per_utterance_wer
per_utterance_wer.definition: Distribution of per-utterance word error rates under the named policy. The micro-average is a separate number. A mean of rates hides a catastrophic utterance, so both are reported. Utterances without a defined rate stay in n_total.
per_utterance_wer.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

streaming_rtfx.name: streaming_rtfx
streaming_rtfx.definition: Successfully transcribed audio seconds divided by the wall-clock span of the measured cell, warmup excluded from the span. Under real-time pacing this tracks stream count: it is a concurrency measure, not a speedup and not an inference-speed number. The numerator is productive audio only. Without a client send trace the ratio is unqualified, because pacing fidelity is what says the client actually paced.

offline_rtfx.name: offline_rtfx
offline_rtfx.definition: Successfully transcribed audio seconds divided by the wall-clock span of an unpaced offline cell. A throughput ratio. Not interchangeable with streaming RTFX. A streaming cell with pacing disabled is not this measure.

prefix_violations.definition: Count of prefix checks that fail, with no normalization. Each recorded interim is checked against the next interim, and each recorded interim is checked against the final. One interim can contribute twice. An interim count without interim text is not this measure.

revision_rate.definition: Revised whitespace tokens divided by newly emitted whitespace tokens. The first interim contributes every token; each later interim contributes only tokens past the common token prefix of the previous interim. A revised token falls outside the common token prefix of the following interim, or of the final for the last interim. Not a word error rate. Cross-cadence transcript agreement is not this metric and is not a pass condition.

goodput.name: goodput
goodput.definition: Measured sessions that simultaneously were admitted, produced a first partial, met the named latency SLO on that session's own samples, completed, and — when a reference was declared — scored within the accuracy tolerance, divided by the measured cell wall span in seconds. Not computed while the sustainability policy is unevaluable, so a missing steady interval cannot become a goodput.

sustained_streams_at_slo.name: sustained_streams_at_slo
sustained_streams_at_slo.definition: Largest offered concurrency at which the full pass conjunction still holds. One cell reports its offered lanes and whether its conjunction passed. It does not invent a sweep maximum. A sweep projection may take the maximum passing lanes across receipts that share an operating point aside from lane count.

unavailable.name: emission_lag
unavailable.definition: A word's audio ending to that word's first appearance in any output. Requires construction-time ground truth: silence of an exact frame count between known utterances. Not inferred by a forced aligner or a voice-activity detector.

unavailable.name: lag_excess
unavailable.definition: Emission lag minus the cadence's theoretical floor: what the implementation costs above what the configuration costs. Unavailable when emission lag is unavailable. Raw emission lag is not compared across cadences.

unavailable.name: interim_cadence_conformance
unavailable.definition: Distribution of inter-interim arrival intervals against the configured cadence. Unavailable until outcomes carry interim arrival timestamps.

conjunction.definition: A cell passes only when every clause passes on that cell: admission fraction, first-partial presence, the latency SLO at the declared percentile of the named latency metric, the named sustainability policy, and accuracy within tolerance under the named normalization policy. The named latency metric is ttfs, response_latency, finalization, or frontier_lag. TTFS stays selectable and is secondary. The headline latency measures are finalization and frontier lag. An unevaluable clause fails the conjunction. The report names the clause. Cross-cadence transcript agreement is not a clause.

clauses.name: latency_slo
clauses.detail: ttfs p99 on mock/simulated_first_audio_to_first_nonempty_partial is 0.25 against SLO 1.0

clauses.name: sustainability
clauses.detail: Fraction of measured sessions that completed. A named policy a preset may select in place of the steady-interval condition. It is not that condition.

audio.definition: attempted_audio_s sums clip duration over every measured session, including failures. successful_audio_s sums clip duration over productive sessions only. Both are reported.
audio.productive_definition: A measured session that was configured, received a non-empty final transcript, and was not timed out and not errored.

counts.definition: Counts over every measured session. attempted is the population. admitted is configured. completed is a terminal transcript without timeout or protocol error, including an empty transcript. productive is completed with a non-empty transcript. timed-out and errored are mutually exclusive, and a timeout wins when both signals are present. no-first-partial overlaps those buckets. lane_unavailable counts sessions the adapter labeled as an entitled lane this process could not open. Warmup sessions are excluded from attempted and recorded as warmup_excluded.

ttfs_s.name: ttfs_s
ttfs_s.definition: Seconds from the first audio sample transmitted to the first non-empty partial, on one client monotonic clock. Connection, configuration, and admission wait are not included. Under riva-grpc real-time pacing the first chunk is sent one chunk after the schedule origin, once that chunk could have been captured, so TTFS starts after that wait, as riva_streaming_asr_client's first send does. A session with no non-empty partial stays in n_total and is absent from n_with_measure. This is not a vendor response latency and not vLLM TTFT.
ttfs_s.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

response_latency_s.name: response_latency_s
response_latency_s.definition: Seconds from the most recent audio transmitted to each non-empty interim, on one client monotonic clock. One sample per response, not per stream. Not TTFS. Client and server clocks are never subtracted.
response_latency_s.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

Unpaced, chunk_latency_s is not_applicable (pacing_disabled), as riva_client_compat_s is. n_responses, n_bursts (consecutive responses under CHUNK_LATENCY_BURST_GAP_S apart), and n_text_repeats (consecutive identical interim texts) are diagnostics. Not finalization_s.
chunk_latency_s.final_flags_inferred_definition: When an outcome carries no response_final_flags (receipts before schema 6), a session with no interim at all is taken to have sent finals only; otherwise every response, the real final included, is taken as non-final, so n_chunks_covered_by_final reads 0 for those sessions.
chunk_latency_s.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

server_audio_rtfx.name: server_audio_rtfx
server_audio_rtfx.definition: Offline only. Sum over completed requests of the server's audio_processed on the last result of each response, divided by the benchmark wall span: riva_asr_client's throughput numerator. gap_vs_clip is server audio over completed clip audio minus one. mismatch is true when the absolute gap exceeds SERVER_AUDIO_RTFX_MISMATCH_TOLERANCE, meaning the server counted a different amount of audio than the clip holds. Unavailable when a completed request carried no audio_processed. Not applicable in streaming mode.

pacing_fidelity.name: pacing_fidelity
pacing_fidelity.definition: Per paced session with a client send trace, the lag of chunk i is its send time minus (audio clock origin + E_i), where E_i is the cumulative audio end of chunk i, min(audio duration, (i + 1) * chunk_ms). Every chunk is scored, the shorter last chunk included. The origin is the recorded schedule origin, so a late first chunk is visible; see AUDIO_CLOCK_ORIGIN_DEFINITION for outcomes that did not record one. Positive is late. Lags from every measured session are pooled. max_session_lag_s is the largest lag in any session. A validity check on every other latency in the cell, not a performance number. A session without a send trace stays in n_total and contributes no lag.
pacing_fidelity.tolerance_definition: A paced cell is paced when every measured lag is at most max(5 ms, 5% of chunk_ms), against latencies of a few to a few hundred milliseconds. Up to one chunk_ms it is pacing_lagged. Beyond one chunk it is unpaced: the client fell behind real time, so throughput and latency describe the client as well as the server. Only paced feeds a comparable NVIDIA row.
pacing_fidelity.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

wer.definition: Word error rate (substitutions + alignment deletions + insertions + deletions_from_missing_transcript) / reference words, micro-averaged, under the named normalization policy. A session with a reference and no transcript stays in the denominator as deletions_from_missing_transcript and is not an alignment deletion. n_failed counts those sessions. A received empty transcript is an empty hypothesis and its deletions are alignment deletions. A session with no reference stays in n_total and is absent from n_with_measure. Undefined when the reference-word denominator is zero and any edit remains.
wer.normalization_definition: engine_vs_own_oracle compares raw text after whitespace tokenization only. No case-folding, no punctuation stripping, no tag stripping, and no number normalization.
wer.cer_definition: Character error rate under the same named normalization policy as the accompanying WER, over the normalized utterance text. Not interchangeable across policies.
wer.sdi_definition: Alignment substitutions, deletions, and insertions counted separately from deletions_from_missing_transcript. The backtrace is deterministic: on a cost tie it prefers a substitution, then a deletion, then an insertion.

per_utterance_wer.name: per_utterance_wer
per_utterance_wer.definition: Distribution of per-utterance word error rates under the named policy. The micro-average is a separate number. A mean of rates hides a catastrophic utterance, so both are reported. Utterances without a defined rate stay in n_total.
per_utterance_wer.population_definition: n_with_measure counts outcomes, or samples where the metric says so, that possess the measure. n_total counts the measured population, including failures. Percentiles are conditional on n_with_measure. An empty sample is an absent percentile, not zero. Neither count is omitted.

streaming_rtfx.name: streaming_rtfx
streaming_rtfx.definition: Successfully transcribed audio seconds divided by the wall-clock span of the measured cell, warmup excluded from the span. Under real-time pacing this tracks stream count: it is a concurrency measure, not a speedup and not an inference-speed number. The numerator is productive audio only. Without a client send trace the ratio is unqualified, because pacing fidelity is what says the client actually paced.

offline_rtfx.name: offline_rtfx
offline_rtfx.definition: Successfully transcribed audio seconds divided by the wall-clock span of an unpaced offline cell. A throughput ratio. Not interchangeable with streaming RTFX. A streaming cell with pacing disabled is not this measure.

prefix_violations.definition: Count of prefix checks that fail, with no normalization. Each recorded interim is checked against the next interim, and each recorded interim is checked against the final. One interim can contribute twice. An interim count without interim text is not this measure.

revision_rate.definition: Revised whitespace tokens divided by newly emitted whitespace tokens. The first interim contributes every token; each later interim contributes only tokens past the common token prefix of the previous interim. A revised token falls outside the common token prefix of the following interim, or of the final for the last interim. Not a word error rate. Cross-cadence transcript agreement is not this metric and is not a pass condition.

goodput.name: goodput
goodput.definition: Measured sessions that simultaneously were admitted, produced a first partial, met the named latency SLO on that session's own samples, completed, and — when a reference was declared — scored within the accuracy tolerance, divided by the measured cell wall span in seconds. Not computed while the sustainability policy is unevaluable, so a missing steady interval cannot become a goodput.

sustained_streams_at_slo.name: sustained_streams_at_slo
sustained_streams_at_slo.definition: Largest offered concurrency at which the full pass conjunction still holds. One cell reports its offered lanes and whether its conjunction passed. It does not invent a sweep maximum. A sweep projection may take the maximum passing lanes across receipts that share an operating point aside from lane count.

unavailable.name: emission_lag
unavailable.definition: A word's audio ending to that word's first appearance in any output. Requires construction-time ground truth: silence of an exact frame count between known utterances. Not inferred by a forced aligner or a voice-activity detector.

unavailable.name: lag_excess
unavailable.definition: Emission lag minus the cadence's theoretical floor: what the implementation costs above what the configuration costs. Unavailable when emission lag is unavailable. Raw emission lag is not compared across cadences.

unavailable.name: interim_cadence_conformance
unavailable.definition: Distribution of inter-interim arrival intervals against the configured cadence. Unavailable until outcomes carry interim arrival timestamps.

conjunction.definition: A cell passes only when every clause passes on that cell: admission fraction, first-partial presence, the latency SLO at the declared percentile of the named latency metric, the named sustainability policy, and accuracy within tolerance under the named normalization policy. The named latency metric is ttfs, response_latency, finalization, or frontier_lag. TTFS stays selectable and is secondary. The headline latency measures are finalization and frontier lag. An unevaluable clause fails the conjunction. The report names the clause. Cross-cadence transcript agreement is not a clause.

clauses.name: latency_slo
clauses.detail: ttfs p99 on mock/simulated_first_audio_to_first_nonempty_partial is 0.25 against SLO 1.0

clauses.name: sustainability
clauses.detail: Fraction of measured sessions that completed. A named policy a preset may select in place of the steady-interval condition. It is not that condition.

audio.definition: attempted_audio_s sums clip duration over every measured session, including failures. successful_audio_s sums clip duration over productive sessions only. Both are reported.
audio.productive_definition: A measured session that was configured, received a non-empty final transcript, and was not timed out and not errored.
